# Parcel delivery

## State machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    Booked
    Collected
    AtHub
    HeldByCustoms
    OutForDelivery
    Delivered
    AttemptFailed
    ReturnedToSender
    Cancelled
    [*] --> Booked
    Booked --> Cancelled : CancelBooking [role = Shipper] / Audit:BookingCancelled
    HeldByCustoms --> AtHub : ClearCustoms [role = CustomsOfficer] / Audit:CustomsCleared
    Booked --> Collected : CollectParcel [role = Driver and assigned] / Audit:ParcelCollected, Notification:ShipperToldCollected
    OutForDelivery --> Delivered : Deliver [role = Driver and assigned] / Audit:ProofOfDelivery, Notification:ShipperToldDelivered
    AtHub --> HeldByCustoms : HoldForCustoms [role = CustomsOfficer] / Audit:CustomsHold, Notification:RecipientToldDutyDue
    AtHub --> OutForDelivery : LoadVan [role = Driver and assigned] / Audit:LoadedForDelivery, Notification:RecipientToldEta
    OutForDelivery --> AttemptFailed : RecordMissedDelivery [role = Driver and assigned] / Audit:DeliveryAttemptFailed, Notification:RecipientToldMissed
    AttemptFailed --> AtHub : ScheduleReattempt [role = HubOperator] / Audit:ReattemptScheduled
    AttemptFailed --> ReturnedToSender : ReturnToSender [role = HubOperator] / Audit:ReturnedToSender, Notification:ShipperToldReturned
    Collected --> AtHub : ScanIn [role = HubOperator] / Audit:HubScanIn
    Delivered --> [*]
    ReturnedToSender --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]
```
